items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Gene Michael(?) could tell you who this man was.

ctx.x: Gene Michael(?) could tell you who this man was. He'd come to your house, and then give them a lesson. A calculation on how this resolved into this, like a checker...like chess. This resolves into that, and it's resolved into this, and there was a calculation of how you do every... Him and Lloyd Phillips used to talk every night.
Lloyd was a fabulous piano player.
